interpretations: For results with grid position 12 or greater, calculate each driver’s total points and average completed laps, then average those two driver-level values across drivers.
For results with grid position greater than 12, calculate each driver’s total points and average completed laps, then average those two driver-level values across drivers.
For results with a starting rank of 12th or better (grid positions 1–12), calculate each driver’s total points and average completed laps, then average those two driver-level values across drivers.
For results with a starting rank better than 12th (grid positions 1–11), calculate each driver’s total points and average completed laps, then average those two driver-level values across drivers.
queries:
WITH driver_stats AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        SUM(points) AS total_points,
        AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS avg_completed_laps
    FROM results
    WHERE grid >= 12
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points,
    AVG(avg_completed_laps) AS avg_completed_laps
FROM driver_stats

SELECT
    AVG(total_points) AS average_total_points,
    AVG(average_laps) AS average_completed_laps
FROM (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        SUM(points) AS total_points,
        AVG(CAST(laps AS INTEGER)) AS average_laps
    FROM results
    WHERE grid > 12
    GROUP BY driverId
)

SELECT
    AVG(total_points) AS average_total_points,
    AVG(average_laps) AS average_completed_laps
FROM (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        SUM(points) AS total_points,
        AVG(CAST(laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps
    FROM results
    WHERE grid BETWEEN 1 AND 12
    GROUP BY driverId
)

WITH driver_totals AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        SUM(points) AS total_points,
        AVG(CAST(laps AS INTEGER)) AS avg_completed_laps
    FROM results
    WHERE grid BETWEEN 1 AND 11
    GROUP BY driverId
)
SELECT
    AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points,
    AVG(avg_completed_laps) AS avg_completed_laps
FROM driver_totals
